# Claude Code Subagent Check

> Paste a Claude Code subagent definition and find why it never gets delegated to: bad name, vague description, wrong tools or model. Runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/claude-code-subagent-check/)
